newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo NBY leaves discount rate unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Yugo NBY leaves discount rate unchanged.

text.p: The National Bank of Yugoslavia (NBY) left its key discount rate for January unchanged at 4.5 percent per month, the central bank confirmed on Monday.
It is the eighth consecutive month that the discount rate has stayed unchanged at an annual 68.15 percent.
The discount rate was cut to 4.5 percent last June from 6.31 percent in May.

NBY sets its discount rate each month using a basket that includes interest rates on the open money market and its short-term bonds, price rises, expected monetary developments, credit demand and money supply. -- Gordana Filipovic, Belgrade newsroom, +381 11 222 4254
